messages:
incident-bot: ⚠️ ALERT: High 5xx rate + sustained tail latency detected in eu-west-az3 model-serving pool. Trigger: latency>500ms for 10m, 5xx_rate>8%. Auto-page fired to on-call rotation. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/az3-capacity-burst

maria: acked. I'm on it, grabbing initial metrics.

kevin: thanks — I'm switching to incident view. maria can you grab `kubectl get pods -n models -l pool=eu-west-az3 -o wide` and paste node kicks?

maria: output pasted — lots of pod restarts on shard-model-12 and shard-model-13, OOMKilled on multiple replicas. Node pressure visible on gpunode-az3-07 (mem: 92%).

maria: logs from model container: ```
2026-03-14T10:02:13Z ERROR runtime: out of memory allocating KV cache
2026-03-14T10:02:14Z WARN eviction: dropping prefixes to free 120MB
2026-03-14T10:02:15Z ERROR http: handler crashed: write tcp 10.0.4.12:8080: broken pipe
```

devon: looks like kernel oom + frequent GC. Could be quantized model memory regression from yesterday's rollout. Any recent model variant pushes?

ashley: FYI we promoted q8-fastvariant v2.3.1 to eu-west yesterday at 03:15. CI-verify green but might have different working set memory. Rolling that back if needed.

kevin: good catch. routing-bot: initiate traffic shed to avoid further customer impact — reduce new requests to az3 by 70% and shift to eu-west-az2 and eu-west-az4. Also enable fallback to cpu-backed small-instance pool for free-tier only.

routing-bot: routes updated: az3 weight=30% -> az2:50% az4:20%. Fallback pool enabled for free-tier. (note: this will increase p99 latency for free-tier, but preserves availability)

maria: initiating emergency rollback of q8-fastvariant v2.3.1 in az3 -> rolling back to v2.2.9. Command run: ``kubectl set image deployment/q8-fastvariant q8=model:q2.2.9 -n models --record``

devon: I'm watching autoscaler — az3 GPU pool hasn't scaled because we've hit per-AZ cap. Asking infra to temporarily raise cap + allow burst. ops-sre, can you lift the reserved capacity for eu-west-az3 by 2 GPUs?

ops-sre: acknowledging. Increasing reserved capacity now, ETA ~3 minutes. Also kicking a host reboot of gpunode-az3-07 to clear memory fragmentation.

maria: rollback is in progress — pods terminating and recreating under v2.2.9. New pods are status Running, initial healthchecks passing.

ashley: quick customer-impact note: realtime inference SLIs show ~12% of requests hitting 5xx during the peak window; affected requests concentrated on customers with pinned az3 model routing (notably tenant:acme-marketing). Not a global outage but degraded for some.

kevin: please open an incident summary and tag SRE/Customer Success. We need to notify impacted customers with planned remediation ETA. Who will draft? devon can you draft initial blurb.

devon: drafting: "We experienced elevated error rates and latency in eu-west-az3 between 09:55–10:03 UTC due to a memory regression triggered by a recent model variant rollout. Automatic traffic shifting and model rollback have been executed; capacity raised and nodes rebooted. We will monitor for the next 30 minutes and follow up with postmortem." Sending to cs-review channel for approval.

maria: rollback succeeded, pod restarts dropped to normal. 5xx rate dropping toward baseline. Current 5xx_rate=1.1%, p95 latency=220ms.

ops-sre: reserved capacity increased, host reboot finished on gpunode-az3-07 — no further OOMs observed in logs post-reboot.

routing-bot: confirming weights restored to normal gradually: az3 -> 70% over 10m ramp. az2/az4 weights shifted down.

kevin: handoff note — I'll be primary for the next 30 minutes while on-call rotation finishes. maria, please keep monitoring error budget and kvcache eviction rate; devon please coordinate customer notification.

maria: monitoring dashboards refreshed, setting alert thresholds lower for next hour. Adding extra logging to kv cache metrics.

devon: CS updated and sent to impacted customers: acme-marketing, bakery-inc, and fintech-labs. They requested ETA; communicated 30m window and that rollback and routing changes are in effect.

ashley: quick follow-up: will do a canary test across regions for q8-fastvariant before the next promotion. Also will run memprofile on v2.3.1 in a staging az to validate working set.

kevin: great. Closing the page once 5xx<1.5% for 20m and kvcache evictions back to baseline. If anything resurfaces, we escalate to SEV1. Thanks team :thumbsup:

incident-bot: AUTO: page cleared — alert condition recovered for eu-west-az3. Trigger window ended. Metrics: 5xx_rate 0.9%, p95 latency 200ms. Incident thread remains open for postmortem drafting.

maria: adding timeline notes to the incident doc and flagging change: model variant v2.3.1 memory footprint incompatible with az3 node type. Will add remediation: stricter mem smoke tests + per-variant mem annotations.

kevin: handing back to oncall rotation. I am clear — leaving handoff to next on-call.

ops-sre: marking infra actions completed in runbook: capacity-increased, node-rebooted.

devon: creating postmortem ticket and linking this thread. Thanks all.
